shortDescription: Import an ISO file to a content library from a remote source.

options.name: checksum
options.description: The checksum that should be used to validate the upload. O(checksum_algorithm) is required if this is provided. This is not used if the source is an ISO. In that case he local file size is used to validate the upload.

options.name: checksum_algorithm
options.description: The checksum algorithm to use when validating uploads. This is required if O(checksum) is provided. This is not used if the source is an ISO. In that case he local file size is used to validate the upload.

options.name: description
options.description: A description for the ISO item in the content library.

options.name: dest
options.description: The destination name of the ISO item in the content library. If an item with the same name already exists, the module will not update it.

options.name: fail_on_warnings
options.description: Cause the module to treat any warnings thrown during the file upload process as errors.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: library_id
options.description: The ID of the library to search within. One of O(library_id) or O(library_name) must be provided.

options.name: library_name
options.description: The name of the library to search within. One of O(library_id) or O(library_name) must be provided.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_protocol
options.description: The proxy connection protocol to use. This option is used if the correct proxy protocol cannot be automatically determined.

options.name: src
options.description: The source ISO file that should be imported to the content library. This can be a local path or a URL. If it is a local path, it should be a valid path on the Ansible host. If it is a URL, its scheme can be HTTPS, HTTP, or datastore (ds://). The file is acquired directly from the vCenter appliance. The module will not encode URLs for you. If this is a URL with special characters (like $ or ~), you should use the urlencode filter. Required when state is present.

options.name: ssl_thumbprint
options.description: The SSL thumbprint of the source URL, if it uses HTTPS. This is ignored for other schemes. If this is not provided, whatever certificate is presented will be trusted.

options.name: state
options.description: Controls if the ISO file should be present or absent in the content library.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout period in seconds for uploads to complete.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
